text: The ME will work on the look-and-feel of the remote and add a screen on top.
The UI Designer will compile a list of functions for display on the LCD and design a multi-page LCD menu with layers.
Maps with all collected data will be created by the User Interface Designer.

Decisions set two function groups (simple for public and advanced for experienced users) and define a target group aged 16 to 40, with a screen on the remote and two menus: a button menu and LCD options.
The menu will be organized into display and basic functions groups with a dividing line, and extra advanced options will appear in the onscreen display.
